task_name: Explorer navigation and state fixes D1-D7
description: D1: App.tsx mounts the Metaproject view on first visit through a new exported RetainedView and keeps it mounted and hidden afterwards (still inside the cwd-keyed ProjectWindow and the cwd-keyed Explorer). D2: useExplorerNavigation gains a stable navigate() (history entry that carries list/panel scroll, optionally resetting the content pane) and stable visit/back/switchView; Graph selections (list, canvas, relationship rows), Wiki result selections and OpenSpec location changes are history entries; re-selecting the shown node adds nothing (it only reopens a closed panel); query edits, filters and panel close/resize stay setRoute. D3: the first-Wiki-page default applies only while the Wiki query is empty; with a query and no selection the article area shows an EmptyState naming the query with a Clear search action; switching the OpenSpec collection keeps the query. D4: Wiki-mode neighbours read uses depth 1, direction both and all kinds except defines/calls (v1 or v2 list by protocol); Graph keeps its filters. D5: rebuild() writes state unless the explorer unmounted (mounted ref), so a catalog reload during a rebuild no longer leaves the button stuck and the catalog is re-read on success. D6: optional negotiate prop (defaults to negotiateMetaproject; when given, negotiation runs even with injected request fakes); the failure banner has Retry, which re-negotiates and keeps the banner until success; 'Loading project knowledge…' and 'Checking OpenSpec support…' are hidden while the error shows. D7: Wiki links are percent-decoded, a leading '/' resolves from the repository root, a path not among loaded nodes triggers one search read with an exact node.path match, and an unresolved or undecodable path shows an inline status naming it.

noticed_not_touched.what: OpenSpecView's choose() sets the content pane's scrollTop to 0 before calling onLocation, so the history entry being left records scroll 0 and Back to a previous OpenSpec entry returns to the top of its document instead of where the user was.

Back to a Graph node that was opened from a lookup result (not in catalog, hits or projection) can show no panel if knownSelection has since moved to another node, because activeNode is resolved only from loaded nodes or the last knownSelection.

assumptions: Every distinct OpenSpec location reported through onLocation (entry, artifact, section or fragment change) is a history entry; equal locations add nothing.
For AC14 a catalog reload is any re-run of the catalog effect; the test triggers it by passing a new request function for the same project.
A Graph selection keeps the list and panel scroll of the entry being left; a Wiki or OpenSpec selection resets only the content pane, as the old code did for Wiki.

behavior_changes.description: Wiki article area with a query and no selection: EmptyState titled 'Choose a result for “<query>”' when there are results, or 'No Wiki page matches “<query>”' otherwise; body text 'Pick a page from the results to read it.' / 'Searching the Wiki…' / 'Clear the search to read the first Wiki page.'; one 'Clear search' button that clears the Wiki query (not a history entry), after which the first Wiki page shows again.
alternatives: One fixed title such as 'No page selected for “<query>”' regardless of results
Clear search also returns to the previous route instead of showing the first page

behavior_changes.description: Switching the OpenSpec collection (Specs / Changes / Archive) now keeps the search query for every switch, not only after 'Find an OpenSpec document'.
alternatives: Keep the query only when the route came from 'Find an OpenSpec document' and clear it on manual switches as before

behavior_changes.description: Unresolved Wiki link messages, shown as an inline status line above the article body: 'No indexed project file at <path>.', 'Could not look up <path>: <error>' and, for an href that cannot be percent-decoded, 'The link <href> is not a valid repository path.' The message clears on the next link click and is hidden when another page is selected.
alternatives: Show it as a warning banner with role=alert at the top of the content area
Open the Wiki search with the path as query instead of a message

behavior_changes.description: Clicking the already-shown Graph node while its panel is closed reopens the panel without a history entry; while the panel is open it does nothing. The negotiation Retry button stays enabled while a retry is in flight and shows no pending state; the error banner stays until a negotiation succeeds.
alternatives: Treat reopening the panel as a history entry
Disable Retry and label it 'Retrying…' while negotiation is in flight
